$schema_note: ARCHIVE — records removed from the live hupsim data files when the project scope was reduced to the HUP West Philadelphia campus only (2026-08; see roadmap/README.md decision record: archive, don't delete). The compiler never reads this file. Entries are verbatim copies, provenance intact, from hup_topology.json (topology_nodes, topology_edges), units.json (units), and layout.json (layout_buildings, layout_insets). CAUTION: the bldg.hup_cedar layout footprint vertices are IN THE TRANSLATED INSET FRAME — the real OSM footprint was translated ~2.8 km NE from the true site (39.9515,-75.2296) for display as an inset. They are NOT real coordinates.
reason: Scope reduced to the HUP West Philadelphia campus: HUP Cedar (detached site, deliberately falsified inset footprint), Penn Medicine Radnor, the Interventional Support Center, and four unmapped/vestigial HUP Main wings (Gibson, Donner, Devon, Centrex) are out of scope.

hup_topology.known_limitations: No public floor-by-floor directory exists for Gibson, Donner, Devon, or Centrex; their contents were inferred from scattered practice-location pages. (The same limitation applies to the retained Maloney and White wings; that half of the sentence stays in the live file.)
hup_topology.open_questions: Does the Centrex Building still exist under that name? It appears in the archival building list but not in the current Facilities wing enumeration.

Whether Gibson or Donner retain any licensed beds - no source affirms beds, but no source explicitly denies them either. The absence-of-evidence here is from a wayfinding document, which lists only rooms a visitor might be sent to. (The same question for the retained Maloney and White wings stays in the live file.)
